text: On Halloween night, the outcast Angela throws a party for a handful of teenagers at Hull House, [an abandoned mortuary with a gruesome past|threat|evil places]. The radio dies, and Angela holds a séance as a party game, until a demon appears in the mirror and [breaks free from the crematorium below|trigger|calling on unseen powers]. One kiss at a time it [passes from guest to guest|rules|it passes to others], and the survivors find the house walled in with no way out before dawn.
